items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And I played a job with Mike not too long ago with Val Barbaro.

ctx.x: Did you know Curly Lozano over on the golf course? Oh yes sir.

Where was he from? I can't say. But he was over there. Yeah. You know the Karuba family, Mike and all, you know Mike. I know Mike, yes. Well I, well there was a family of Karubas that lived in Long Beach and I think Mike must be part of that family. Mm-hmm. I couldn't say. And I played a job with Mike not too long ago with Val Barbaro.

Yeah. But Curly, you knew Curly over there and did you play with him? No. See, I just was curious about that. Well you're talking about your work and everything. Did you, when did you start tuning pianos?
